test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which year was the percentage share of investment in the Defence sector the lowest as compared to all three sectors for that year?
solution:
**Given:**

Investment in 3 sectors for 5 different years

**Calculation:**

In the year 2004

Investment in the defense sector = 247.76 

Total investment in 3 sectors = ( 247.76 + 120.41+ 87.5 ) = 455.67

Percentage share = (247.76 /455.67) × 100 = 54.37%

In the year 2005

Investment in the defense sector = 223.84 

Total investment in 3 sectors = ( 223.84 + 121.47 +84.45) = 429.76 

Percentage share = (223.84/429.76) × 100 = 52.08 %

In the year 2006

Investment in the defense sector = 243.67 

Total investment in 3 sectors = (243.67 + 187.98 + 81.23) = 512.88

Percentage share = (243.67/512.88) × 100 = 47.51%

In the year 2007

Investment in the defense sector = 217.46

Total investment in 3 sectors = ( 217.46 + 205.67 + 80.76) = 503.88

Percentage share = (217.46/503.88) × 100 = 43.15%

In the year 2008

Investment in the defense sector = 219.64

Total investment in 3 sectors = ( 219.64 + 119.35 + 98.14) = 437.13 

Percentage share =( 219.64/437.13) × 100 = 50.24%.

Since, 43.15% is the lowest among all .So, 2007 is the year in which investment percentage of defense sector is the lowest.

**Hence, the year in which investment percentage of defense sector is lowest is 2007.**
